title: Queue a message sent while Claude is busy, shown grey until picked up
notes: Claude Code: Enter while busy queues the message, drawn grey until taken; it can be withdrawn. SDK: the CLI queues streamed input itself; cancel_async_message (sdk.d.ts:3991) is internal, unverified on Query. Pane: send() has no busy check (chat-view.ts:278) and main echoes the prompt as already sent (chat-sessions.ts:273). Size M.

comments.body: PR #114: prompts sent while busy queue grey under the conversation, taken on command_lifecycle; Up in the empty box withdraws the last one. 2.10.0.

Shipped in PR #114: a message sent while Claude is busy waits grey in the session's queue until taken, Up in the empty box withdraws the last one, and the queue survives the session's own /clear. Version 2.21.0.
